content: Data Safety form rejections in 2026 mostly stem from drift: form doesn't match actual SDK behavior (Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/FCM count as data collection even if 'no ads'), privacy policy wording contradicts the form, or account-deletion link is missing/broken/marked incorrectly. Google tightened enforcement (Apr 2026) on undisclosed third-party SDK data collection -- re-audit the form after every SDK version bump, not just at submission.
